binding_constraint: AUTHOR CAPACITY — human time to write per CAQS §4 standards. Factory tools reduce boilerplate and formatting time (~20%) but core authoring time (accounting knowledge + pedagogical judgment) is invariant.

minimal_viable_playbook.recommendation: Create EW Authoring Playbook (1 session) instead of full factory infrastructure. Includes: 3-4 EW templates by question type, misconception seed library for top 20 tested concepts, automated pre-cert QA lint script. Investment: 1-2 sessions for ~40% of factory's velocity improvement at 25% of the cost.
